strings.ca.title: Castle of Shadows
strings.ca.tagline: An isolated castle opens its gates to you, then shifts its corridors around you. Between portraits, deserted rooms, and hidden passages, the place keeps the trace of those who enter.
strings.ca.s01.title: The road below
strings.ca.s01.body: You cut the engine. The castle towers over the hill, massive and silent. The wind smells of wet stone, like an open cellar.
strings.ca.s02.title: The yielding gate
strings.ca.s02.body: The rusted gate is not really locked. A broken chain hangs like a warning. Your phone gets a signal… then loses it.
strings.ca.s02.c1: Push the gate open and go in
strings.ca.s02.c3: Go back and look for another entrance
strings.ca.s03.title: Side path
strings.ca.s03.body: The trees swallow the sounds. The castle disappears for a second behind the branches… then reappears closer.
strings.ca.s03.c1: Go back to the main entrance
strings.ca.s03.c3: Circle around to the hall door
strings.ca.s04.title: Inner courtyard
strings.ca.s04.body: The courtyard is overgrown with brambles. An eroded statue watches you with no face. All the windows are open, but nothing moves.
strings.ca.s04.c2: Go through a wide open window
strings.ca.s05.title: Grand hall
strings.ca.s05.body: The hall smells of cold dust. The chandelier is dark, but the shadow it casts looks too sharp. The door behind you feels heavier than before.
strings.ca.s06.title: Echo of footsteps
strings.ca.s06.body: Every step repeats with a slight delay, as if someone is copying the way you walk. You can make out three possible directions.
strings.ca.s07.title: Air too still
strings.ca.s07.body: The silence is so heavy you can almost hear your own blood. A draft comes from nowhere, like a sign.
strings.ca.s07.c3: Go to a door you had not noticed
strings.ca.s08.title: Grand staircase
strings.ca.s08.body: The steps are coated in a film of dust… except for one clean strip, like a recent path. Up there, a dark landing.
strings.ca.s08.c3: Go back down and head to the ballroom
strings.ca.s09.title: Hallway of doors
strings.ca.s09.body: A long hallway, identical doors, peeling wallpaper. Halfway down, one door is open by a fraction of an inch.
strings.ca.s09.c3: Follow the hallway until it changes
strings.ca.s10.title: Shifted hallway
strings.ca.s10.body: The angles are no longer the same. A door has appeared where there used to be only a wall. The castle changes distances for no reason.
strings.ca.s10.c1: Go back to the normal hallway
strings.ca.s10.c3: Look for a marker in the walls
strings.ca.s11.title: Portrait gallery
strings.ca.s11.body: Faded faces, pitted frames. Some gazes seem to follow where you stand, but only when you look away.
strings.ca.s11.c2: Move a frame hanging upside down
strings.ca.s12.title: Frame without a reflection
strings.ca.s12.body: One frame has been cleaned, as if someone wiped it recently. Behind it, a mark on the wall: part of a symbol.
strings.ca.s12.c1: Examine the mark, then move on
strings.ca.s12.c2: Go back to the warped hallway
strings.ca.s13.title: Tall library
strings.ca.s13.body: The shelves rise too high to be practical. A rolling ladder is jammed. At the center, a writing desk waits for you.
strings.ca.s14.title: Writing desk
strings.ca.s14.body: A notebook lies open. A torn page rests right beside it, as if left there on purpose. The ink of the last word is not fully dry.
strings.ca.s15.title: Incomplete sentence
strings.ca.s15.body: In the notebook, a sentence cuts off suddenly: “The key is under…” The rest has been torn away. You get the feeling someone was here a second ago.
strings.ca.s16.title: Ballroom
strings.ca.s16.body: Worn mirrors, heavy curtains, creaking floorboards. The room seems larger than the outside of the castle should allow.
strings.ca.s16.c3: Look for a way out toward the kitchens
strings.ca.s17.title: Floorboards that answer
strings.ca.s17.body: Under your steps, the floorboards seem to react in an unnatural way. One mirror reflects an angle that does not exist. You do not want to stay here.
strings.ca.s18.title: Cold kitchen
strings.ca.s18.body: Rusting metal, damp air, the smell of old grease. On a table, a knife… but no dust around it, as if it had been moved.
strings.ca.s18.c1: Follow the door toward the cellar
strings.ca.s19.title: Storage room and silence
strings.ca.s19.body: Empty cupboards. A hook on the wall still holds a label, unreadable now. On the floor, footprints stop abruptly in front of a wall.
strings.ca.s19.c3: Go through the new door in the warped hallway again
strings.ca.s20.title: Stone staircase
strings.ca.s20.body: The staircase drops into thick darkness. The air grows damp, almost warm. The farther you go, the more you feel this part of the castle has been used recently.
strings.ca.s20.c3: Look for a side door on the landing
strings.ca.s21.title: Cellar corridor
strings.ca.s21.body: Sweating stones, slow drops of water. A door at the far end is slightly ajar. To the right, an alcove too black to see into.
strings.ca.s22.title: Untouched wine cellar
strings.ca.s22.body: Racks, empty bottles… except for one, sealed and untouched. Near it, a small recorder covered in a fine layer of dust.
strings.ca.s22.c1: Take the recorder, then inspect the sealed bottle
strings.ca.s22.c2: Calmly return to the cellar corridor
strings.ca.s22.c3: Leave the cellar as fast as possible
strings.ca.s23.title: Sealed bottle
strings.ca.s23.body: With the recorder in your pocket, you return to the bottle. The wax is perfect. Too perfect. When you touch it, you feel a vibration, like a voice being held back. You have no desire to open it.
strings.ca.s23.c1: Go back to the cellar corridor
strings.ca.s23.c2: Go back up and look for another route
strings.ca.s23.c3: Leave the cellar as fast as possible
strings.ca.s24.title: A door that was not there
strings.ca.s24.body: The door that appeared in the warped hallway forces a simple choice on you: enter, or step back before it vanishes. The air behind it smells of cold incense.
strings.ca.s24.c2: Step back into the warped hallway
strings.ca.s25.title: Private chapel
strings.ca.s25.body: A cracked stained-glass window, dust… and a recent candle. The flame does not flicker. Someone came here, and not a hundred years ago.
strings.ca.s25.c2: Explore the back of the chapel
strings.ca.s25.c3: Go back toward the new door
strings.ca.s26.title: Altar
strings.ca.s26.body: A prayer book lies open. An old key rests on it, like an offering. The pages were turned recently.
strings.ca.s26.c3: Stay a moment longer at the altar
strings.ca.s27.title: Sound beneath the tiles
strings.ca.s27.body: The moment the key leaves the altar, a dull sound runs through the chapel, like a lock snapping open far away. You have just allowed something.
strings.ca.s27.c3: Head toward the winter garden glass roof
strings.ca.s28.title: Winter garden
strings.ca.s28.body: Under the cracked glass roof, dead plants and the smell of cold earth. A bench has been moved, revealing a clean patch on the floor.
strings.ca.s29.title: Under the glass roof
strings.ca.s29.body: A straight mark cuts through the dust, as if an object had been dragged recently. The castle is not truly abandoned: something still moves through it and leaves fresh traces behind.
strings.ca.s29.c1: Go to the room of mirrors
strings.ca.s30.title: Servants’ quarters
strings.ca.s30.body: Iron beds, lockers, stiff sheets. A name is carved into one locker. Yours should not be there.
strings.ca.s31.title: Empty lockers
strings.ca.s31.body: Almost all of them are empty, except one: a scrap of cloth caught inside, as if torn from recent clothing. And the smell of soap.
strings.ca.s31.c1: Go to the room of mirrors
strings.ca.s31.c3: Climb back up toward the tower
strings.ca.s32.title: Room of mirrors
strings.ca.s32.body: The reflections do not agree with one another. In one, you are at a different door. In another, you are standing behind yourself.
strings.ca.s33.title: Cold hand
strings.ca.s33.body: At your touch, the mirror is icy like a tombstone. A silhouette passes through one reflection without a sound. You know you have just been seen.
strings.ca.s34.title: Back to the landing
strings.ca.s34.body: You find the grand staircase again. The dust has changed: the clean strip is wider now. Something went up while you were elsewhere.
strings.ca.s35.title: Tower spiral
strings.ca.s35.body: The spiral staircase swallows the light. The air is drier. With every step, you feel this tower follows an older, stricter logic than the rest of the castle.
strings.ca.s35.c2: Go back down to the landing
strings.ca.s36.title: A step too high
strings.ca.s36.body: One step is unnaturally high, as if the castle is trying to make you stumble. You set your foot down, and everything holds… for now.
strings.ca.s36.c3: Head back to the warped hallway
strings.ca.s37.title: High chamber
strings.ca.s37.body: A round table, an old map, a sketched symbol. A map fragment is trapped under a box. Another mark shows the orientation.
strings.ca.s37.c2: Study the symbol and memorize it
strings.ca.s38.title: Map that does not want you
strings.ca.s38.body: The map has impossible markers: rooms that overlap. But the symbol stays steady. It may be the only reliable marker.
strings.ca.s38.c2: Go back down toward the staircase
strings.ca.s39.title: Chalk mark
strings.ca.s39.body: A mark on the floor: an arrow pointing “below.” The castle speaks in gestures, not words. You understand where to look for a passage.
strings.ca.s39.c1: Follow the clue toward beneath the castle
strings.ca.s39.c3: Go back to the warped hallway
strings.ca.s40.title: Attic
strings.ca.s40.body: Beams, trunks, thick dust. One object is too clean, as if it had just been set down. And the air is colder here than in the cellar.
strings.ca.s40.c3: Go back to the warped hallway
strings.ca.s41.title: Open trunk
strings.ca.s41.body: Inside the trunk, a bookmark, a folded letter, and an empty space the size of your hand. It looks like a place being kept for something.
strings.ca.s42.title: Letter without a date
strings.ca.s42.body: The letter has no date. It speaks of a path behind the walls, and of proof to gather before the crypt.
strings.ca.s42.c1: Keep the proof and return near the trunk
strings.ca.s43.title: Violent return
strings.ca.s43.body: The warped hallway throws you back near a familiar door. You realize some parts of the castle deliberately lead you back to specific areas.
strings.ca.s43.c1: Go toward a more stable corridor
strings.ca.s43.c3: Follow a feeling toward the gallery
strings.ca.s44.title: Ancient lock
strings.ca.s44.body: One door has an ancient lock. You feel the chapel key might fit. Without it, the door is just another wall.
strings.ca.s44.c1: Use the key if you have it
strings.ca.s45.title: Door open
strings.ca.s45.body: The door gives way, but the air beyond is warmer, like a breath. It does not feel like you are entering a simple room: everything seems connected to something.
strings.ca.s45.c2: Follow a trail on the floor
strings.ca.s46.title: Shifted shelves
strings.ca.s46.body: A gap between two shelves is too clean. The dust forms a sharp line, as if a piece of furniture sometimes slides there.
strings.ca.s47.title: Under the desk
strings.ca.s47.body: Under the desk, a magnetic tape, or a small cassette. The label is faded, but one word still stands out: “PROOF.”
strings.ca.s48.title: Desk closed again
strings.ca.s48.body: When you lift your head, the notebook is closed. No one is there. And yet, you understand someone let you do this.
strings.ca.s48.c3: Go back to the warped hallway
strings.ca.s49.title: Upside-down portrait
strings.ca.s49.body: One portrait hangs upside down. On the back of the frame, a carved sentence: “DO NOT FOLLOW THE MUSIC.”
strings.ca.s50.title: Split frame
strings.ca.s50.body: A black thread is caught in the split of the frame, like a hair. You do not know why you understand it: this is not human.
strings.ca.s51.title: Back in the ballroom
strings.ca.s51.body: The ballroom is identical… except one mirror reflects a hallway you have never seen. The castle offers you a shortcut.
strings.ca.s51.c3: Stay in the center and listen
strings.ca.s52.title: Lying reflection
strings.ca.s52.body: The mirror shows you a passage and a silhouette at the far end. But the floor, in the reflection, does not have the same dust. The mirror is cheating.
strings.ca.s53.title: Hallway regained
strings.ca.s53.body: You find a normal hallway again. That is exactly what worries you: in this castle, what looks simple usually hides a trap.
strings.ca.s53.c1: Follow a door that calls to you
strings.ca.s53.c3: Go back down toward the cellar
strings.ca.s54.title: Impossible angle
strings.ca.s54.body: The hallway bends at an angle that should not exist here. One door has fresh fingerprints on it. The place is in use.
strings.ca.s55.title: Cellar landing
strings.ca.s55.body: On the wall, a mark: three lines and a circle. It looks like the tower symbol, but in a simpler form.
strings.ca.s56.title: The alcove
strings.ca.s56.body: A stone panel sounds hollow. You understand it: there is an empty space behind it. But you can only open it if you know how.
strings.ca.s56.c3: Go back to the ground floor
strings.ca.s57.title: Secret passage
strings.ca.s57.body: The panel gives way, revealing a narrow passage. The stones are worn from repeated use. The castle has its own inner circulation.
strings.ca.s58.title: Narrow step
strings.ca.s58.body: The passage slopes down and then up again, as if to throw off your sense of direction. You can smell the cold stone of a nearby crypt.
strings.ca.s58.c1: Go all the way to the end
strings.ca.s58.c3: Move forward with your hands on the walls
strings.ca.s59.title: Crypt entrance
strings.ca.s59.body: Niches, silence, a symbol on the floor. The air is dry, almost ancient. You know that here, the castle no longer plays games: it judges.
strings.ca.s59.c2: Go back toward the secret passage
strings.ca.s60.title: At the heart of the crypt
strings.ca.s60.body: The symbol is complete in the center, like an engraved mechanism. Nothing moves… except the dust, which forms a faint circle.
strings.ca.s60.c1: Look for how to validate the symbol
strings.ca.s61.title: The ballroom closes in
strings.ca.s61.body: You return and the ballroom feels too ready. The curtains are drawn tighter. You have the feeling of being watched by an invisible audience. This is a false exit.
strings.ca.s62.title: Courtyard, cold breath
strings.ca.s62.body: Outside, the air should feel freeing… but it clings to your skin. The gate is far away, and the statue seems to be turned toward you now.
strings.ca.s63.title: The gate in sight
strings.ca.s63.body: The gate is there, open. Too open. You feel it is not just a way out: it is a final test.
strings.ca.s63.c3: Go back to the ballroom to look for another exit
strings.ca.s64.title: Last threshold
strings.ca.s64.body: The gate waits for you in the fog. The danger may not only be leaving, but leaving too early without understanding what the castle wants from you. If you choose the right moment, you can cross the threshold.
strings.ca.s64.c3: Return to the hall to understand
strings.ca.s65.title: Hall, impossible return
strings.ca.s65.body: The hall is identical, but the main door is darker. The echoes of footsteps are sharper. You feel the castle responds differently to your presence now.
strings.ca.s66.title: Total distortion
strings.ca.s66.body: The hallway becomes almost alive. The doors seem to breathe. If you choose wrong, you always end up back in the ballroom.
strings.ca.s66.c1: Follow the portraits, the stable marker
strings.ca.s66.c3: Go back toward the ballroom circle
strings.ca.s67.title: Portraits, warning
strings.ca.s67.body: One portrait has its eyes scratched out. In their place, a sentence: “THE EXIT IS NOT ALWAYS OUTSIDE.”
strings.ca.s68.title: Mirrors, call
strings.ca.s68.body: The mirrors send back a movement to you: a door opening inside a reflection. You know it is a shortcut… or a perfect trap.
strings.ca.s68.c1: Ignore it and return to the warped hallway
strings.ca.s69.title: Altar, return
strings.ca.s69.body: The altar is empty now. The prayer book is closed. As if the place were saying: “too late.” You do not like that tone.
strings.ca.s70.title: The link comes together
strings.ca.s70.body: The clue comes back to you all at once. The mark seen above, the cellar, the alcove, and the crypt all form the same path. You finally understand that what lies beneath the castle opens with the right reading of the symbol, not with force.
strings.ca.s70.c1: Go back down to the alcove, secret passage
strings.ca.s70.c2: Go to the heart of the crypt
strings.ca.s71.title: Attic, back to the bookmark
strings.ca.s71.body: The trunk is still open. The bookmark in your hand suddenly feels important, as if it serves as a passage or a temporary permission.
strings.ca.s72.title: Crypt, mechanism
strings.ca.s72.body: The symbol on the floor has a central place, like a lock. You have what you need to activate it… if you truly understood the castle.
strings.ca.s73.title: The complete proof
strings.ca.s73.body: The symbol reacts. The dust begins to turn. You feel one last thing is still needed: the key, the correct reading of the symbol, and the fact that you truly entered the crypt.
strings.ca.s73.c1: Align what you understood and continue
strings.ca.s74.title: Breaking the link
strings.ca.s74.body: The circle opens like a clean crack. For one second, you understand the castle was trying to keep a link with you. You can break that link, or choose a more ordinary exit.
strings.ca.s75.title: Hallway, final stretch
strings.ca.s75.body: The hallway is stable, almost ordinary. That is exactly what worries you: in this castle, what seems normal often hides the last trap.
strings.ca.s76.title: Ballroom, circle
strings.ca.s76.body: The mirrors seem aligned. The curtains form a perfect oval. You sense a faint presence, like an assembly waiting for your choice. At the back of the room, a discreet opening appears along the axis of the circle.
strings.ca.s76.c3: Follow the hidden opening toward the crypt
strings.ca.s77.title: Gate, hesitation
strings.ca.s77.body: The gate marks the separation between the castle and the outside world. And yet, you feel that truly getting out still depends on what you understood here.
strings.ca.s77.c3: Go back to the hallway to retrace your path
strings.ca.end_good.title: Ending, Cold Dawn
strings.ca.end_good.body: You cross the gate. The morning air burns your lungs. Behind you, the castle looks normal…
strings.ca.end_bad.title: Ending, Closed Circle
strings.ca.end_bad.body: You stay. The curtains close. The mirrors no longer show you. You understand too late: you are now part of the castle, motionless, put away with the rest.
strings.ca.end_secret.title: Secret Ending, Break
strings.ca.end_secret.body: The symbol activates. The dust spins, then drops all at once. You feel the link snap cleanly. The castle is finally empty.
strings.ca.h.s14.soft: The torn page is not mandatory, but it remains a truly useful piece of evidence.
strings.ca.h.s14.strong: Take the page from the desk. Flag: has_diary_page. It strengthens the scenario’s coherence, without being required to get out.
strings.ca.h.s26.soft: The altar does not offer a key to open a door, but a key to change the castle.
strings.ca.h.s26.strong: Take the key. Flag: has_chapel_key. It is required for the secret ending route and unlocks the locked hallway door, scene s44.
strings.ca.h.s37.soft: The symbol is the only stable element when everything else moves.
strings.ca.h.s37.strong: The most important thing here is understanding the symbol. Flag: knows_symbol. The map fragment remains useful, but only the symbol is required to open the alcove to the secret passage.
strings.ca.h.s47.soft: The castle’s music is its way of guiding you to the wrong place.
strings.ca.h.s47.strong: Take the recording. Flag: has_recording. It is useful evidence for the atmosphere and for understanding, but it is no longer required for the secret ending.
strings.ca.h.s56.soft: A secret door does not accept force. It accepts a rule.
strings.ca.h.s56.strong: Without knows_symbol, you cannot open the alcove to the secret passage.
strings.ca.h.s73.soft: The crypt does not judge you on courage, but on coherence.
strings.ca.h.s73.strong: To continue toward breaking the link, you need three elements: has_chapel_key, knows_symbol, and entered_crypt.
strings.ca.clue.entered_crypt.title: Crypt reached
strings.ca.clue.has_chapel_key.title: Chapel key
strings.ca.clue.has_diary_page.title: Diary page
strings.ca.clue.has_map_fragment.title: Map fragment
strings.ca.clue.has_recording.title: Recording
strings.ca.clue.has_signet.title: Bookmark
strings.ca.clue.knows_symbol.title: Symbol understood
